Application channel: a Moroccan Bac holder applies via Études en France (Campus France), not Parcoursup, so applicationChannel is omitted as instructed. Intakes: the 1 October–15 November 2026 dates come from the ADIUT Maroc page for first-year BUT applications via Études en France (Maroc). The Parcoursup page dates (candidatures analysed April-May 2026, responses from 2 June 2026, orals 10 April–20 May 2026) concern the Parcoursup route for French/European Bac holders. General average and subject results (maths, scientific subjects, French, English) are admissions criteria, not minimum grade requirements.
